correctness.rationale: Source formula yields weighted Schwarzian −[A w(z)²+b conjugate(z)w(z)+3 conjugate(z)²/2], with A=(alpha²−1)/2>0, b=alpha−1>0 and w=(1−r²)/(1−z). Reverse triangle gives |w|≤1+r and triangle inequality the circle bound; at z=r all three terms align exactly, so upper bound achieved. If r>0, strict |1−z|>1−r unless z=r yields unique maximizer. Profile derivative 2A(1+r)+b(1+2r)+3r positive, limit norm 4A+2b+3/2. Deficit factors (1−r)[A(3+r)+b(2+r)+3(1+r)/2]. Near-max sequence must have r→1 and |w|→2, so (1−r)/|1−z|→1 implies angular direction→0 and z→1. alpha=1 endpoint deliberately excluded from angular uniqueness; nonattainment for alpha>1 clear.
